what: Component-tolerance Monte-Carlo of the SPICE bank (R +-1%, C +-5%, GBW +-20%)
verdict: Across 16 component-tolerance device instances (R +-1%, C +-5%, GBW +-20%) the five-class accuracy is 0.377 +- 0.012 (nominal 0.398), and the realized Q spans 35-43: classification is robust to realistic component tolerances, with the Q spread the dominant non-ideality.
